title: Supplier catalog for household containers
rationale: Independently specified supplier catalog transfer. Product identity and carton contents retain meaning; package roles, units, and unsupported import administration do not become direct equivalents.

source.name: qty_per_case
source.concept: Number of individual sale items in a supplier case.

source.name: net_weight_kg
source.concept: Product contents mass in kilograms, excluding all packaging.

source.name: title
source.concept: Public product display name.

source.name: shade
source.concept: Unqualified visible product color.

source.name: audit_batch
source.concept: Internal identifier of the supplier export audit batch.

target.name: colour
target.concept: Unqualified visible product color.

target.name: item_name
target.concept: Public product display name.

target.name: shipping_weight_kg
target.concept: Packed shipping parcel mass in kilograms.

target.name: inventory_sku
target.concept: Supplier's stock reference for a purchasable product.

target.name: items_per_carton
target.concept: Number of individual sale items in a supplier case.

target.name: color

labels.rationale: Both columns identify the supplier stock item.
Both count individual items within one supplier case.
The available contents mass uses grams; the kilogram alternative measures the packed shipping parcel. Neither is a direct field equivalent.
Both are the public product name.
Both target spellings denote color and neither carries a distinguishing role or observations.
The target has no supplier export audit batch identifier.
